name: @projexlight/sdk-media
summary: Binary-asset layer for ProjexCloud: presigned upload + playback URLs for blobs, content-addressable storage (SHA-256), and transcode/derivation jobs for video + image variants. Decouples 'where do the bytes live' from 'who can use them' so sdk-evidence + hdk-camera + sdk-content can move large objects through the platform without holding bytes in app memory.

endpoints.description: Get a presigned PUT URL for a new blob. Mobile/web client uploads directly to S3 (or equivalent), bypassing our API tier.
Mark a blob upload as committed; emits .ingested.v1 so downstream SDKs (evidence, content) can pick it up.
Get a presigned GET URL for download/playback. Scoped TTL.
Kick off a transcode/derivation job (e.g. video → 720p + thumbnails, or PDF → searchable PDF).
Job status: pending / processing / done / failed + the derived blob_ids when done.

events.name: media.blob.ingested.v1
events.description: Client committed a blob upload; carries blob_id + sha256 + mime + size.

events.name: media.blob.playback_requested.v1
events.description: Playback URL issued; used for access auditing + cost attribution.

events.name: media.transcode.completed.v1
events.description: Transcode/derivation job finished; carries the derived blob_ids.

events.name: media.blob.deleted.v1
events.description: Blob deleted (retention expiry / tenant offboard); carries blob_id + reason.

models.description: Per-blob row: blob_id, sha256, mime, size, storage_uri (s3://…), ingested_at, retention_class.
Per-issued-url row: blob_id, kind (upload/download), issued_to_persona, expires_at.
Per-job row: source_blob, derivation_kind, status, derived_blob_ids, started_at, finished_at.

hooks.name: getUploadUrl
hooks.description: Issue a presigned PUT URL for a new blob. Returns blob_id (placeholder) + url + headers.

hooks.name: markBlobReady
hooks.description: Confirm a blob upload — server verifies the SHA-256 + emits .ingested.v1.

hooks.name: getPlaybackUrl
hooks.description: Issue a presigned GET URL for an existing blob. TTL respects tenant + retention policy.

hooks.name: startTranscode
hooks.description: Queue a transcode/derivation job (video → 720p, PDF → OCR, image → thumb).

hooks.name: startRetentionShredder
hooks.description: Background worker: deletes blobs past their retention_class TTL. Emits .deleted.v1 per blob.

scenarios.title: Tech mobile app uploads a proof-of-work photo
scenarios.when_to_use: Mobile client gets a presigned URL, uploads the photo directly to S3 (skipping our API), then calls markBlobReady to commit.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Blob row written, .ingested.v1 emitted. sdk-evidence picks it up + binds to the encounter without ever touching the bytes.

scenarios.title: Adjuster reviews evidence photos
scenarios.when_to_use: Insurance adjuster opens a claim; UI fetches presigned download URLs to render the proof photos.
scenarios.expected_outcome: URL valid for 5 min; emits .playback_requested.v1. Adjuster's browser fetches directly from S3 (no API bandwidth).

scenarios.title: Body-cam video → 720p + thumbnail for review
scenarios.when_to_use: Body-cam upload is 4K; transcoder produces a 720p variant for fast review + a thumbnail for the evidence-list grid.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Job queued; worker picks it up + writes derived blobs. Emits .transcode.completed.v1 with the derived blob_ids. sdk-evidence variants point at the derived blobs.

scenarios.title: Daily worker deletes expired blobs
scenarios.when_to_use: Blobs tagged retention_class='evidence-7-year' delete on day 7×365+1; 'operational-30-day' deletes after 30 days. Background worker drives the schedule.
scenarios.example_code:
import { startRetentionShredder } from '@projexlight/sdk-media';
startRetentionShredder({ tenant_id, interval_min: 60 });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Per-tick scan deletes blobs past TTL; emits .deleted.v1 per blob. Customer can prove deletion to their regulator.

scenarios.title: Tenant offboard → shred all blobs
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on tenant.offboarded.v1 — scrub every blob_id for the tenant. Idempotent on the (tenant_id) key.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Every blob deleted; emits .deleted.v1 per blob. Sync history retained but with storage_uri tombstoned.

compliance_posture.notes: SHA-256 content-addressable storage means any byte tampering shows up as a mismatch. Presigned URLs scoped per persona + audited via .playback_requested.v1. Storage region pinned per tenant for EU residency. Cryptographic erasure for HIPAA + GDPR via vault-key shred on the blob's wrapping key.
